title: How Ryanair makes money on £15 flights

scenes.say: This Ryanair flight cost me fifteen quid. The taxi to the airport cost forty. So how did Ryanair make over two billion euros profit last year?
Trick one. The ticket is just the bait. The real money is everything else. Bags. Seats. Priority boarding. That's almost five billion euros of extras.
Trick two. Cheap airports. Ryanair will fly you to Paris.
Well, Beauvais. About eighty five kilometres away. Small airports charge airlines much lower fees, so Ryanair saves millions.
Trick three. One type of plane. Almost every Ryanair jet is a Boeing seven three seven, bought hundreds at a time for big discounts. Same parts, same training, cheaper everything.
Trick four. Planes that never sit still. A Ryanair jet lands, empties, refills and takes off again in about twenty five minutes. A plane on the ground makes no money.
Trick five. No frills. No free food, no screens, and seats that don't recline. Tiny savings, times two hundred million passengers, add up to a fortune.
So that fifteen pound flight isn't a loss. It's the hook. Follow for more money secrets.
